pins.name: INT
pins.notes: LOW on a CAN event. 5 V when powered from 5 V: use a divider

pins.name: SO
pins.notes: 5 V when powered from 5 V: use a divider or level shifter

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Needs 5 V for the TJA1050 transceiver: use VIN

pins.name: H
pins.notes: CAN high. To the bus, never to the ESP32

pins.name: L
pins.notes: CAN low. To the bus, never to the ESP32

sources.section: SPI interface, INT output; supply 2.7 to 5.5 V
